$comment: The chat kit's shopping list (see app/src/components/chat/CHAT-KIT.md). resync.mjs copies exactly these into a consumer tree; files stay read-only there and fixes flow through THIS source (the napkyn resync contract). Paths are app-relative.

cssBlocks.$comment: index.css is shared page-wide, so these travel as MARKED BLOCKS to lift, not files: search each marker in src/index.css.

appDependencies.$comment: What the vendored set imports from the host app: the consumer maps these to its own equivalents (they are the domain seam, not part of the kit).

components/BasketAvatar, BasketBento, BasketSpark, ChainBadge, DexSwapCard, SpectrumLoader, MigrateModal (the REAL cards)
